task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the medium sauce can with the right arm and relocate it near the grey kitchenpot
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架用右臂拾取中号酱罐，并将其重新放置在灰色厨房锅附近
